legacyPersist.derivation_note: Appended by mkMicrovmConfig; storage helpers can explicitly supply the same persist layout.

externalShares.derivation_note: NFS export/target derive from mediaStorage; rw is NFS module default. This is not an extra virtiofs share.

dependencies.detail: Default gateway uses WireGuard VM; explicit LAN/shared-bridge return routes come from vpnReturnRoutes.
Quadlet/Podman LinuxServer Firefox: profile maps to /config and dedicated Downloads maps to /downloads. Profile UID 911 remains separate from admin UID 1000; shared transfer GID is 1000.
Browser username/password SOPS declarations order credentials before startup.
Host NFS server enabled; checked public exports block is commented and module default is empty. Working export cannot be assumed.

storageNotes: All proposed state PVCs are fresh and blank; source images/mounts are provenance only.
Legacy /persist identity/credentials are not copied; the fresh retained root holds new guest OS state until a per-service identity design is approved.
External media/NFS/virtiofs paths are not mounted by groundwork.
Sizes mirror declared budgets, not observed usage. Review free space, filesystem overhead and restore needs before resuming storage.
